post.summary: New - Withdraw one or more pending approval requests
post.description:
Attempts to withdraw each listed pending approval request independently. A failure on one item does not
prevent the others from being processed. Returns HTTP 204 NoContent when every item succeeded, or HTTP 207
Multi-Status when at least one item failed. The 207 response contains total_count, accepted_count, failed_count,
and fault details for each failed identifier.
Each identifier specifies either approval_request_uuid or external_request_id.

post.summary: New - Send manual notifications for approval requests
post.description:
Sends manual reminder notifications to approvers on gates in PENDING_APPROVAL state, independently
for each listed approval request. The service enforces batch limits on the notify payload. Returns
HTTP 204 when every listed request was fully notified, or HTTP 207 Multi-Status when at least one
request was throttled, not eligible, or failed delivery — per-request errors appear as a fault inside
the 207 body, not as a top-level status. An approval_request_uuid that is unknown or outside your
organization group access fails the entire batch with 404, rather than producing a per-item fault.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Approval requests to notify.(Required).

204.description: Every listed approval request was fully notified — all eligible gates delivered, and none were throttled.

207.description: At least one request was throttled, not eligible for notification, or failed delivery. Response contains total_count, notified_count, failed_count, and faults for each failure.

400.description: 7408 The notify request is invalid: no requests listed, duplicates, malformed identifiers, or the batch is larger than allowed. 7401 A required UUID is missing or not a valid identifier string.

403.description: 7421 You do not have the governance permission needed for this operation or scope. 7422 A governance rule or the current approval state does not allow this action. 11 Global organization group cannot be used for this operation.

404.description: 7411 The organization group was not found, is outside your access, or cannot be used for this operation. 7412 No approval request was found for that identifier, or you do not have access to it.

post.summary: New - Activate one or more gates on a pending request
post.description:
Transitions one or more gates from CREATED to PENDING_APPROVAL, making them available for approver decisions.
Only gates in CREATED state can be activated. All gates must have been defined at request-creation time;
the approval request is immutable after creation.
This operation is all-or-nothing: if any gate in the batch is not found or is not in CREATED state,
the entire request fails and no gates are modified.

parameters.name: approvalRequestUuid
parameters.description: Approval request that owns the gates.(Required).

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Gate identifiers to activate.(Required).

200.description: All requested gates are now in PENDING_APPROVAL state.
